# VKS geometry and measurement locations

Source papers: `Bourgoin2002`, `Monchaux2007`, `Ravelet2008`, `Monchaux2009`.

## Main geometry

| Quantity | Symbol | Value | Unit | Source |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| Inner cylinder radius | R_c | 0.206 | m | Monchaux2009 |
| Inner cylinder length | H_c | 0.524 | m | Monchaux2009 |
| Impeller radius | R | 0.1545 | m | Monchaux2009 |
| Impeller separation | L_imp | 0.371 | m | Monchaux2009 |
| Impeller blades | N_blades | 8 | - | Monchaux2009 |
| Blade height | h | 0.0412 | m | Monchaux2009 |
| Midplane annulus inner diameter | D_ann | 0.175 | m | Monchaux2007 |
| Midplane annulus thickness | e_ann | 0.005 | m | Monchaux2007 |
| Outer sodium vessel diameter | D_outer | 0.578 | m | Monchaux2009 |
| Outer sodium vessel length | H_outer | 0.604 | m | Ravelet2008 |
| Sodium volume | V_Na | 0.150 | m^3 | Monchaux2009 |
| Hall array spacing | delta_r_array | 0.028 | m | Monchaux2009 |

## Probe locations

Normalized coordinates are (r/R_c, theta, x/R_c).

| Probe | Coordinates | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | (1, pi/2, 0) | Midplane, flush with inner shell |
| P2 | (1, pi/2, 0.53) | 109 mm from midplane |
| P3 | (0.25, pi/2, -0.53) | Bulk, near one impeller |
| P4 | (0.25, pi/2, 0.53) | Bulk, symmetric point |
| P5 | (1, pi, 0) | Midplane boundary point |
